asset.title: Collect feedback where it happens
asset.content:
Subject: Collect feedback where it happens
Preview text: Start with one focused question, then place the form on the page where it matters.

Ask the question on the page

Hi there,

Ask one focused product question at the point where someone is using the feature it concerns. They can respond there, without being sent to a separate form page.

Tally is an online form builder that lets you create the form first, then render it inline on your website. To embed it, add Tally’s widget script and an iframe with `data-tally-src` to the page.

Start with one question on one relevant page. It is a practical way to see how Tally fits your product-feedback loop before deciding where else a form would be useful.

You can create unlimited forms and submissions free while your use stays within Tally’s fair usage guidelines.

Create a free form → https://tally.so/create

- Tally

asset_metadata.single_idea: Tally lets a product team put a feedback form directly on its own page and start collecting submissions with unlimited forms and submissions free within fair usage guidelines.

selected_brief.selection_reason: Embedded feedback collection is relevant across the selected product-team audience without assuming a particular destination or installed stack, and the documented free offer gives a new buyer a concrete reason to act now.

value_case.reader_benefit: A product team can place a feedback form directly on a website or product page and collect submissions without paying per form or submission while its use remains within Tally's fair usage guidelines.
value_case.mechanism: Tally renders the form inline through its widget script and an iframe, while its free offer includes unlimited forms and submissions within fair usage guidelines.
decision_conditions: The unlimited free offer is subject to Tally's fair usage guidelines.
The documented embed is the standard website widget-and-iframe mechanism and requires adding the widget script and an iframe with data-tally-src.

claim_conditions: Keep 'unlimited' attached to the fair usage condition.
Describe only the documented website iframe/widget embed, not native mobile or SDK support.
Add the Tally widget script (https://tally.so/widgets/embed.js) and an iframe with data-tally-src to the host page (R12).
A free Google account is required for the Google Sheets integration (R3).
A webhook endpoint must return a 2XX status within 10 seconds or the documented retry sequence applies (R13).

The embed documentation covers the standard website iframe/widget mechanism only and does not state native in-app mobile SDK support, and the free unlimited-submission offer is bounded by the fair use guidelines whose example threshold is 50,000 submissions/month sustained for 3-4 months.
selected_brief.target_audience: SaaS/startup product teams building feedback loops
selected_brief.job: Get a new buyer to create a free form for a product-feedback use case.
selected_brief.single_idea: Tally lets a product team put a feedback form directly on its own page and start collecting submissions with unlimited forms and submissions free within fair usage guidelines.
selected_brief.mechanism: The team creates a Tally form, then the documented widget script and iframe render it inline on the team's page. Tally's free offer covers unlimited forms and submissions within its fair usage guidelines.
selected_brief.belief_shift: Before: trying another form builder may mean meeting a paywall before a product-feedback workflow is useful. After: Tally can be used to create and embed the form, with unlimited forms and submissions free within fair usage guidelines.
must_not_say: Do not claim Tally is free without the fair usage condition.
Do not describe 50,000 monthly submissions as a hard cap.
Do not promise higher response rates, more revenue, faster research, or better feedback.
Do not claim native mobile SDK or in-app mobile support.
Do not imply that every recipient uses Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, Make, Zapier, or webhooks.
Do not claim Tally eliminates complex field mapping or conditional branches.
Do not make competitor comparisons or exclusivity claims.
Do not add the API, AI, security, GDPR, pricing, language, file-upload, version-history, or full integration catalogue arguments.
Do not make blanket legal or regulatory assurances.
Do not claim Tally Pro costs €20 per month or Tally Business costs €65 per month.
Tally's Pro plan costs €20 per month
Tally's Business plan costs €65 per month
selected_brief.objection: The reader may assume a useful feedback programme will require a paid plan once it has more than a few forms or submissions.
selected_brief.tone: Plainspoken, confident, warm, and concise; mildly anti-paywall without attacking competitors.
selected_brief.next_step_decision: Decide whether Tally is a practical starting point for the team's next product-feedback form.
selected_brief.next_step_value: The destination lets the reader create a Tally form under the documented free offer.
selected_brief.next_step_limit: Creating a form does not by itself validate the website embed in the reader's environment or any downstream integration.
selected_brief.subject_strategy: Lead with the concrete opportunity to put product feedback on the team's own page, while making the free entry point clear without turning the subject into a feature list.
